source_version: Capella (continuously deployed, no discrete version number)

relations.subject: sso:realm
relations.evidence:
Choose to turn on or off group mapping.  
Group mapping allows you to assign roles to SSO users based on which teams map to their SSO group.

relations.subject: sso:realm
relations.evidence:
Choose a default team.  
Capella automatically assigns users to the chosen default team when they do not match any team based on their SSO groups.

notable_absence.finding: The prerequisite admin gate is stated generically - "To sign in to the CyberArk Admin Portal as an admin" - with no named/linked role (contrast sso-entra-id.md's specific, linked "Global Administrator"). Not a docs defect, just a lower level of specificity than some sibling pages.

cross_component_finding: This page and sso-google.md/sso-onelogin.md follow the cleanest version of the templated 3-procedure SAML flow: create the IdP app with no placeholder values required, create the Capella realm, then paste real values back into the IdP app. By contrast sso-okta.md and sso-ping.md require entering placeholder ACS URL/Entity ID values into the IdP app in step 1, to be replaced later - a real (if minor) procedural asymmetry masked by all six pages using identical 'three procedures in the following order' framing language.
